risks.risk: Exact part identification is unclear (could be an engine, engine cover assembly, or a specific engine component). Wrong identification leads to wrong pricing and compatibility issues.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part number/label (close-up of the marking on the black cover and any stickers/plates) plus a photo showing the full assembly from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case generic used engine/major assembly with unknown compatibility and unknown working status.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (may be incomplete, missing sensors/hoses, or not functional).
risks.proof: Video of the item running/tested (or a mechanic’s test report) and photos of all connectors/sensors present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / for parts only.

risks.risk: Compatibility with the buyer’s vehicle is unknown (engine code, year, and model not shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle details plate/engine code from the donor vehicle (or the engine code stamped on the block) and the exact make/model/year.

risks.risk: Damage or missing components may exist but are not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside, both sides, and close-ups of connectors, mounting points, and any cracked/broken areas.

proof_requests: Send a close-up, readable photo of any part number/engine code/label on the black cover and any stickers/plates.
Send photos showing the full assembly from front, back, left, and right (including mounting points).
Confirm completeness: list every sensor/connector/hoses included; send photos of each.
Provide proof of working condition: video of start/test or mechanic test report (and what was tested).
Share donor vehicle make/model/year and engine code (or VIN/engine code photo).
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact item/engine-part identity and working condition cannot be confirmed, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the part number/engine code and proof it’s complete and functional.
